name: Leave Summary Report
query:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Leaves",
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Approved Leaves",
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Pending Leaves",
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Cancelled Leaves"
FROM `tabLeave Request`;
report_script:
def execute(filters=None):

    total = frappe.db.count("Leave Request")
    approved = frappe.db.count("Leave Request", {"status": "Approved"})
    pending = frappe.db.count("Leave Request", {"status": "Pending"})
    cancelled = frappe.db.count("Leave Request", {"status": "Cancelled"})

    columns = [
        {"label": "Total Leaves", "fieldname": "total", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 200},
        {"label": "Approved Leaves", "fieldname": "approved", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 200},
        {"label": "Pending Leaves", "fieldname": "pending", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 200},
        {"label": "Cancelled Leaves", "fieldname": "cancelled", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 200}
    ]

    data = [{
        "total": total,
        "approved": approved,
        "pending": pending,
        "cancelled": cancelled
    }]

    return columns, data
